description: User asked to push a PDF to their reMarkable. Instead of delegating to a general-purpose agent to discover rmapi and the correct push method, Master attempted the task directly using bash and osascript — tools insufficient for discovering and operating rmapi without proper environment context.
correction: Should have spawned a general-purpose agent with instructions to locate rmapi or an equivalent reMarkable CLI tool, generate the PDF, and execute the push. Direct execution was premature given the unknown environment state.
systemic_fix: When a task involves an external device or CLI tool not confirmed to exist, always delegate to a general-purpose agent to discover the tool before attempting direct execution.
